system.description:
Your concentrated blood is so corrosive that a mouthful spat at a foe burns through skin, flesh and bone, reducing it to smoking sludge, though it leaves metal and stone untouched.

Spit a single Blood Trait at a victim as one action; if you succeed at a Physical Challenge to strike, she suffers one level of aggravated damage as the ichor eats through her. You must spew the blood directly — if it misses or lands on an object it loses its toxicity within the turn. The blood must be deliberately converted for this power; your vitae can still be drained normally without poisoning the drinker.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
